description: Binance spot last price for one trading pair (for example BTCUSDT), from Binance's public ticker endpoint. Only the last price is returned; no order book or history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_binance_orderbook_depth when you need Binance spot order book snapshot for one pair: best bid; crypto_tao_alpha_prices when you need alpha token spot price in TAO, pool liquidity, and reserve. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: finance_binance_prices
title: Binance spot last price for one trading pair
